script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --job-name=spire-e4-throughput
#SBATCH --partition=N56_128G_V100
#SBATCH --nodelist=gpu01
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:V100:8
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --mem=96G
#SBATCH --time=02:30:00
set -euo pipefail
ulimit -c 0
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-12.8/lib64
repo=/home/zhuyouwei/sts-silent-gpu-split
build=/home/zhuyouwei/spire-build-e3-v13-5adc725
python=/home/zhuyouwei/spire-env/bin/python
output=/home/zhuyouwei/spire-downloads/e4-throughput-$SLURM_JOB_ID
source=/home/zhuyouwei/spire-downloads/e4-training-3644/A-1729
mkdir -p "$output"
export PYTHONPATH="$build:$repo/tests:$repo"
cd "$repo"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 7c918ddab4039750b3104b96f131155f17ddfce0
git rev-parse HEAD > "$output/source.txt"
sha256sum "$source"/rank-*.pt > "$output/input-checkpoints.sha256"
trap 'code=$?; printf "BENCH_EXIT=%s END=%s\n" "$code" "$(date -Is)"; scontrol show job "$SLURM_JOB_ID" > "$output/accounting-at-exit.txt"' EXIT
SECONDS=0
for setting in 512:32 512:8 256:32; do
  lanes=${setting%:*}
  trials=${setting#*:}
  case_output="$output/L$lanes-N$trials"
  remaining=$((8880-SECONDS))
  if [ "$remaining" -lt 180 ]; then break; fi
  "$python" -m torch.distributed.run --standalone --nnodes=1 --nproc-per-node=8 /home/zhuyouwei/spire-downloads/e4-throughput.py --source "$source" --output "$case_output" --lanes "$lanes" --trials "$trials" --seconds "$remaining"
  reason=$("$python" -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["reason"])' "$case_output/status.json")
  if [ "$reason" != ten_updates_complete ]; then break; fi
done
sha256sum -c "$output/input-checkpoints.sha256"
